title: Invertibility of the canonical open reduction mate
statement: For a prime l, finite coefficient field E, any Operations o and RealizationModel m, and any open immersion j:U->V, every component of m.openReduction(j) is an isomorphism.

source.place: Coefficient-comparison sentence; localization of the ordinary open mate.

proof.text: The good-complex localization integralOperationsGoodLocalization is a localization at quasi-isomorphisms by the proved integralOperationsGoodLocalization_isLocalization helper. Its essential surjectivity gives a flat-term K-flat representative P and an isomorphism Q(P) to the arbitrary derived object K. Naturality, via NatTrans.isIso_app_iff_of_iso, reduces invertibility to the component at Q(P).

For each degree i, apply ordinaryOpenReduction_isIso to P.X i. Hence the complex map ordinary.openReductionComplex is an isomorphism by HomologicalComplex.Hom.isIso_of_components. DerivedCategory.Q preserves that isomorphism.

Apply openReduction_mate_localization to P, obtaining the comparison isomorphisms s and t and the equality openReduction(Q(P)) followed by t.hom equals s.hom followed by Q of the ordinary complex mate. The right side is invertible by the preceding step; cancel the invertible t.hom with IsIso.of_isIso_fac_right. Together with the representative transport this proves the exact given component is invertible for every K, without completeness or quasi-compactness assumptions.

proof_origin.place: Localization of the ordinary open mate. Lean assembly follows the existing private fixedOpenReduction_isIso proof in OpenReconstructionEffectivity, importing only its required lower-level ingredients.
